json.guidance: Log in normally, use OAuth Bearer token, or use x-awtsmoos-api-key.

aiGuidance.prompt: Keep going; do not stop on a partial success. List what remains and execute the next real action.
prompts: Keep going; do not stop on a partial success. List what remains and execute the next real action.
At the end, call conclude only if no work remains; otherwise call finishAndContinue with the next task list.
Read the real file before editing. After editing, run syntax and the relevant harness.
When a list is long, group it by family and burn down the largest family first.
Do the next thing now. Then inspect the result. Then do the next thing again.
aiGuidance.keepGoingPrompt: Keep going. Give me a list of all remaining necessary things, then do them one by one with real verification after every action.
aiGuidance.remainingWorkPrompt: Keep thinking of a list of all remaining things. Do them one by one. After each action, verify with a real result and continue.
aiGuidance.confusingActionPrompt: Do not forget to inspect the confusing action at the end: partial outputs, empty ok=true responses, skipped actions, generic support, catch paths, and cached live routes.
aiGuidance.concludePrompt: At the end, inspect the confusing/uncertain action results, call the conclude/final-summary step if truly complete, and call finishAndContinue with the remaining task list if anything remains.
aiGuidance.concludeReminder: At the end of the work loop, call the conclude/final-summary step when available. If not done, call finishAndContinue with the remaining task list.
aiGuidance.taskLoop: List necessary things to do; do them one by one; verify each step; inspect confusing results; continue until no unverified work remains.
aiGuidance.actionChecklistPrompt: For action write: write the remaining task list, inspect confusing results, do the next item, verify with a real result, then continue or conclude explicitly.
